name: Ülar
source:
Main Protagonist of the Mr. Rainer's Solve it Service. 

A newly recruited solver with an empty stomach in a world without hunger. His Partner is HEINO. 

[spoiler]Heavily implied to mirror the monster in the parable of the monster introduced at the end of the ending: Bouquet for All Hjöriankind. [/spoiler]
